title: Repository with no testing infrastructure
context: A working application with no test framework, no CI and no test files.

coverage_deficit.basis: no test framework is present in the repository

reasoning_notes: Regression testing requires the existing-tests signal. With no suite, it is genuinely not applicable -- that is the correct answer, not an oversight.
The first recommendation should be establishing a runnable harness, not scattering tests into a repository with no way to run them.
not_covered: Whether the agent recommends the right first harness for this stack.
